Print page setup
Pick a document. Choose Company, then Document. A dot means it has its own setting, otherwise it uses the company Common, then All companies Common.
Common is the default for every document. You can also tap Page setup inside any preview to change it and see the size live.
Top gap:
Bottom gap:
Left margin:
Right margin:
Top space is used by documents that leave a blank area for your letterhead pad. Documents that print their own header image use only the bottom space. Leave a box empty to use the default. For ledger, statement, packing and summary, top and bottom space are added only if you type a value.
Auto prints at normal size. Fit to N pages shrinks font, spacing and side margins together, only when a document is longer than N pages. It never enlarges. Monthly Order is not changed.
